trap.label: despite of
trap.wrong: Despite of the rain, we played.
trap.why: O aluno copia "apesar de". Em inglês, despite não leva of (só in spite of).

opts: In spite the cost, we bought it.
In spite of the cost, we bought it.
In spite of it was costly, we bought it.

mcq.q: Complete: She smiled **___** she was tired.

opts: Although it rained, but we left.
Although of the rain, we left.

fix.wrong: Cars are fast, however trains are cheap.
fix.right: Cars are fast; however, trains are cheap.

fix.wrong: In spite the noise, I slept.
fix.right: In spite of the noise, I slept.

fix.wrong: Despite the fact he was ill, he came.
fix.right: Despite the fact that he was ill, he came.

rewrite.prompt: Una com whereas: “Sue likes tea. Joe likes coffee.”
rewrite.answer: Sue likes tea, whereas Joe likes coffee.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com in spite of: “Despite the rain, we left.”

rewrite.answer: Even though he was ill, he came.
